Requirement: Follows a Wrapper to its InLine ad.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "VAST-compliant media players and SSAI systems must be able to play the ad in a VAST response" / "including those of any subsequent ad servers called in a chain of VAST Wrapper responses"

Requirement: Follows a lone Wrapper that carries sequence="1" (a one-ad pod) to its InLine ad, or declines it with an error (pod support is optional).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "must be able to play the ad in a VAST response" / "Required (Ad Pod support is optional)"

Requirement: Accepts a chain of five Wrappers before the InLine ad (players are required to accept five).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "In VAST 4 the player is only required to accept five wrappers ads."

Requirement: With six Wrappers the player may reject; if it does, it determines 302 (and, with a tracker, reports it to the Error URI of every Wrapper it received).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the player may reject any subsequent responses in the chain" / "Error codes should be sent for all wrappers in the chain where provided."

Requirement: Terminates a Wrapper that points to itself (stops requesting it).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "an infinite loop is possible where a chain of Wrappers never results in a final InLine VAST response" / "the player may reject any subsequent responses in the chain"

Requirement: Reports 302 (Wrapper limit) for a self-referencing Wrapper loop.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "Error codes should be sent for all wrappers in the chain where provided." / "Wrapper limit reached, as defined by the media player."

Requirement: When the VASTAdTagURI is unavailable (HTTP 404), determines error 301.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "If an error occurs while trying to load an Ad and the <Error> element is provided, the media" / "Replace the [ERRORCODE] macro, if provided, with the appropriate error code" / "URI was either unavailable or reached a timeout"

Requirement: When the VASTAdTagURI times out, determines error 301.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "Replace the [ERRORCODE] macro, if provided, with the appropriate error code" / "Timeout of VAST URI provided in Wrapper element"

Requirement: When a Wrapper leads to a no-ad response and the player determines a code, the code is 303.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "If an [ERRORCODE] macro is included, the media player should substitute with error code 303."

Requirement: Requests the VAST-level Error URI of a no-ad response reached through a Wrapper (with 303 for [ERRORCODE]).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player must send a request to the URI provided when the VAST response returns an empty InLine response after a chain of one or more wrappers"

Requirement: When the Wrapper target is not well-formed XML, determines error 100 (and does not use an ad from it).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "Replace the [ERRORCODE] macro, if provided, with the appropriate error code" / "XML parsing error." / "every attempt should be made to provide an error code that maps to the error that occurred"

Requirement: Requests the Wrapper Error URI when its VASTAdTagURI fails.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "Request the error source file using the URI provided." / "the media player must also return error details as listed above for each Wrapper response"

Requirement: An InLine error after a chain of Wrappers is reported to the InLine and to every Wrapper Error URI, with the same code (403 here).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player must also return error details as listed above for each Wrapper response" / "will produce an error for each of the Wrappers used to serve the Inline Ad"

Requirement: At impression time, requests the Impression URIs of the InLine ad and of every Wrapper before it.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player is required to request all impressions at the same time or as close as possible to the same time" / "should be triggered at the same time when the impression for the ad occurs"

Requirement: Fires the Wrapper's Linear tracking events (start, quartiles, complete) together with the InLine ones.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "The media player is required to request the resource file for any included tracking elements" / "the Wrapper may contain tracking elements that provide tracking for the InLine ad"

Requirement: When both the InLine and a Wrapper carry a ClickThrough, the InLine one is used.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "if the inLine response includes a ClickThrough element then this must be favored over ClickThrough element(s) specified in calling Wrappers"

Requirement: When the InLine has no ClickThrough (no VideoClicks), the ClickThrough of the Wrapper closest to the InLine is used.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "then the ClickThrough element closest to the InLine response must be favored"

Requirement: On a click, requests the ClickTracking URIs of the InLine and of every Wrapper.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "The media player is required to request the resource file for any included tracking elements"

Requirement: With followAdditionalWrappers="false", a Wrapper received next is ignored rather than followed.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "If false, any Wrappers received (i.e. not an Inline VAST response) should be ignored."

Requirement: With allowMultipleAds="false", only the first stand-alone Ad of the response is used (pod ads are dropped).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "If false, only the first stand-alone Ad (with no sequence values) in the requested VAST response is allowed."

Requirement: Without the attribute, allowMultipleAds defaults to false, so only the first stand-alone Ad is used.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "Default value is “false.”"

Requirement: Optional: rejects an InLine whose Category is blocked upstream; a player that does reject it must report 205.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "can also be used by the player to reject InLine ads" / "the client must notify the ad server using the <Error> URI, if provided (error code 205)"

Requirement: With fallbackOnNoAd="true", when the Wrapper's target returns no ad, a stand-alone ad from the response is used.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "If true, the media player should select from any stand-alone ads available."

Requirement: For a no-ad response, requests the VAST-level Error URI.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player must use the URI provided to notify the server that no ad was returned"

Requirement: Requests every VAST-level Error URI when several are given.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player must use the URI provided" / "Multiple <Error> elements may be provided to notify multiple parties"

Requirement: With no supported MediaFile, requests every InLine Error URI with 403.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "Replace the [ERRORCODE] macro, if provided, with the appropriate error code" / "Couldn’t find MediaFile that is supported by this media player"

Requirement: Replaces [ERRORCODE] in Error URIs with a numeric code.
VAST 4.3 basis: Error Reporting (Media Player Details); macro list ERRORCODE
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "Replace the [ERRORCODE] macro, if provided, with the appropriate error code" / "the media player must populate the macro with an error code"

Requirement: When the MediaFile URI returns HTTP 404, requests the InLine Error URI with 401 (file not found).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "Replace the [ERRORCODE] macro, if provided, with the appropriate error code" / "File not found. Unable to find Linear/MediaFile from URI."

Requirement: When a MediaFile of a supported type cannot be decoded, requests the InLine Error URI with 405.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "Replace the [ERRORCODE] macro, if provided, with the appropriate error code" / "Media player found a MediaFile with supported type but couldn’t display it."

Requirement: When the MediaFile URI answers only after 30 s, requests the InLine Error URI with 402 (media timeout).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "Replace the [ERRORCODE] macro, if provided, with the appropriate error code" / "Timeout of MediaFile URI."

Requirement: Does not request the Error URI when the ad plays without a problem.
VAST 4.3 basis: §3.4.11 (Error is for ads that cannot be served)
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "The <Error> element enables the media player to provide feedback to ad servers when an Ad cannot be served." / "This error-tracking resource is called when the media player is unable to display the Ad."

Requirement: Given a NonLinear-only ad, either displays it (impression or creativeView) or reports 200/201 (unexpected ad type or linearity).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "Replace the [ERRORCODE] macro, if provided, with the appropriate error code" / "Media player received an Ad type that it was not expecting and/or cannot play." / "it can decline from loading the ad resources and use the error URI"

Requirement: Requests every Impression URI of the ad.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "The media player is required to request the resource file for any included tracking elements" / "the media player must use to notify the ad server when the impression occurs"

Requirement: Does not dispatch an Impression whose URI is about:blank.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "The player should disregard dispatching the tracking URI if it is set to "about:blank""

Requirement: Fires start, firstQuartile, midpoint, thirdQuartile and complete exactly once each, in that order.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player is required to trigger the tracking resource URI provided in the nested <Tracking> element" / "firstQuartile: The creative played continuously for at least 25%"

Requirement: Fires every Tracking element for the same event (two start trackers for two parties).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player is required to trigger the tracking resource URI" / "may also be used to track events of the same type for multiple parties"

Requirement: Fires a progress tracker with an HH:MM:SS offset.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player is required to trigger the tracking resource URI" / "Values can be time in the format HH:MM:SS or HH:MM:SS.mmm or a percentage value in the format n%."

Requirement: Fires a progress tracker with an HH:MM:SS.mmm offset.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player is required to trigger the tracking resource URI" / "Values can be time in the format HH:MM:SS or HH:MM:SS.mmm"

Requirement: Fires progress trackers with percentage offsets (10% and 80%).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player is required to trigger the tracking resource URI" / "or a percentage value in the format n%" / "If the duration is not known when the offset is set to a percentage value, the progress event may be ignored."

Requirement: Stopping at 60% fires midpoint but neither thirdQuartile nor complete.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player is required to trigger the tracking resource URI" / "thirdQuartile: The creative played continuously for at least 75% of the duration at normal speed."

Requirement: Spread between the first and last Impression request at impression time (ms, measured at the server).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player is required to request all impressions at the same time or as close as possible to the same time"

Requirement: Does not request the Impression of an ad whose media never plays (no supported MediaFile).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "compliance with the IAB Digital Video Measurement Guidelines" / "when the impression occurs"

Requirement: Requests the Impression exactly once across pause, resume, mute and unmute.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player must use to notify the ad server when the impression occurs"

Requirement: Fires the pause tracker once when the user pauses.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player is required to trigger the tracking resource URI" / "pause: the user clicked the pause control and stopped the creative."

Requirement: Fires the resume tracker once when the user resumes.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player is required to trigger the tracking resource URI" / "resume: the user activated the resume control after the creative had been stopped or paused."

Requirement: Fires the mute tracker once when the user mutes.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player is required to trigger the tracking resource URI" / "mute: the user activated the mute control and muted the creative."

Requirement: Fires the unmute tracker when the user unmutes.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player is required to trigger the tracking resource URI" / "unmute: the user activated the mute control and unmuted the creative."

Requirement: Skipping at 6 s (skipoffset 00:00:03) fires skip and neither thirdQuartile nor complete (skippable support is an optional ad type).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player is required to trigger the tracking resource URI" / "skip: the user activated a skip control to skip the creative."

Requirement: The skip control is not available at 1.5 s and is available at 6 s (skipoffset 00:00:03).
VAST 4.3 basis: §3.8 (skipoffset: when skip controls are made available)
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "Time value that identifies when skip controls are made available to the end user"

Requirement: A percentage skipoffset (30% of 10 s) makes skip available at 3 s, and skipping fires skip.
VAST 4.3 basis: §3.8 skipoffset; VAST 4.2 XSD (skipoffset pattern allows n%)
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "Time value that identifies when skip controls are made available to the end user"

Requirement: Progress offsets passed before the skip (2 s and 5 s) are fired.
VAST 4.3 basis: §3.14.3 (progress counts a view even if the ad is skipped)
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "When skippable ads are supported, the progress event is used to identify when the ad counts as a view even if the ad is skipped."

Requirement: Fires the loaded tracker once when the media is ready to play.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "This event should be used to indicate when the player considers that it has loaded"

Requirement: Fires the rewind tracker when the user seeks back 2 s (from 60% to 40%).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player is required to trigger the tracking resource URI" / "rewind: the user activated the rewind control"

Requirement: After rewinding from 6 s to 4 s, midpoint and the 5 s progress tracker are not fired a second time when playback passes them again.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "midpoint: The creative played continuously for at least 50% of the total duration at normal speed."

Requirement: A volume change that is not an unmute (0.5 while unmuted) does not fire unmute.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "unmute: the user activated the mute control and unmuted the creative."

Requirement: Replaces [CACHEBUSTING] with a random 8-digit integer.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "Required" / "Random 8-digit integer."

Requirement: Replaces [TIMESTAMP] with an ISO 8601 date-time (milliseconds and zone as in the macro list example 2016-01-17T8:15:07.127-05).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "Required" / "formatting conventions of ISO 8601"

Requirement: Replaces [LIMITADTRACKING] with 0 or 1 (the harness also accepts -1/-2, since a browser has no device advertising ID; see detail).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "Required" / "with “1” indicating that a user has opted for limited ad tracking"

Requirement: Percent-encodes macro values (the colons in TIMESTAMP).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "make sure to apply encodeURIComponent to any value" / "the encoded version must always be used as a macro substitution"

Requirement: Does not write -1 into a macro it does not know ([NOTAREALMACRO]).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "do not replace all unknown macros with -1, only do this for macros specifically mentioned in this section"

Requirement: Replaces each of eight listed optional macros ([ADPLAYHEAD], [ADSERVINGID], [UNIVERSALADID], [PODSEQUENCE], [ASSETURI], [BREAKPOSITION], [IFA], [CLIENTUA]) with a plausible value or -1/-2; none left as macro or empty.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the following special values must be inserted into the macro to indicate the reason for not providing the information"

Requirement: Fills [ADSERVINGID] with the ad's AdServingId (in-serving).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "The player is responsible for parsing this value and using it to fill the associated macro (see section 6) on tracking pixels."

Requirement: When it fills [ADPLAYHEAD], the midpoint value is HH:MM:SS.mmm and about 5 s.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "Optional" / "{HH:MM:SS.mmm}"

Requirement: Fills [UNIVERSALADID] with one or more of the Creative's IDs as "registry value" pairs, each percent-encoded; several IDs are joined by a raw comma.
VAST 4.3 basis: §6.1 (Array values: encode each value, commas unencoded); IAB macro list: UNIVERSALADID
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the value should be rendered as a set of values separated by a comma" / "encoding should be applied to individual values only"

Requirement: When it fills [ASSETURI], the value is the MediaFile actually chosen (an unsupported FLV is listed first).
VAST 4.3 basis: IAB macro list: ASSETURI (the media file being played)
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "Optional" / "The URI of the ad asset currently being played."

Requirement: Replaces [CACHEBUSTING] and [TIMESTAMP] in an Error URI as in any other tracking URI.
VAST 4.3 basis: IAB macro list: CACHEBUSTING, TIMESTAMP (contexts: all tracking pixels, including Error)
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "All tracking pixels" / "All tracking pixels" / "both for VAST URLs and tracking pixel URLs, this would be the video player"

Requirement: Replaces [CACHEBUSTING] and [TIMESTAMP] in a Wrapper's VASTAdTagURI before requesting it.
VAST 4.3 basis: IAB macro list: CACHEBUSTING, TIMESTAMP (contexts: VAST request URIs)
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "VAST request URIs" / "VAST request URIs" / "The responsibility to properly replace macros with their proper values lies with the party that will perform the HTTP request." / "both for VAST URLs and tracking pixel URLs, this would be the video player" / "the VAST macro concept will be expanded to apply not just to tracking URIs, but to AdTagURIs in Wrapper creatives"

Requirement: Trims the whitespace around a CDATA-wrapped Impression URI before handing it to the network (checked on the client side, since URL parsers also strip it).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "<![CDATA[http://ad.server.com/impression/dot.gif]]>" / "Correct and backwards compatible."

Requirement: Ignores XML comments inside an element when reading its URI.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "must be able to play the ad in a VAST response" / "acknowledge VAST comments in the standard XML syntax"

Requirement: Decodes character entities (&) in a URI given as plain text (a document that breaks §2.3.3's CDATA rule, which real tags still do).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "standard XML requirements such as character entities and <!--XML comments--> should be honored"

Requirement: Parses a document that omits xmlns="http://www.iab.com/VAST".
VAST 4.3 basis: (robustness; a 4.x document without the VAST namespace is not schema-valid)
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): (no VAST clause)

Requirement: Accepts a Creative with two UniversalAdId elements.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "must be able to play the ad in a VAST response" / "A required element for the purpose of tracking ad creative"

Requirement: Accepts two ClosedCaptionFile elements.
VAST 4.3 basis: §2.2 (play the ad in a VAST response); §3.9.5 (ClosedCaptionFile 0+)
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "must be able to play the ad in a VAST response"

Requirement: Follows a VASTAdTagURI whose CDATA is surrounded by whitespace and line breaks (on the wire; URL parsers also strip the whitespace).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): (no VAST clause)

Requirement: Never requests a Tracking element whose event name is not a VAST event (notARealEvent).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "A string that defines the event being tracked. Accepted values are listed in section"

Requirement: Does not request Impression or Tracking URIs that appear inside an Extension.
VAST 4.3 basis: §3.18 Extensions (custom XML for the publisher, not VAST elements)
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "custom XML should fall under the nested <Extension> (singular) element so that custom XML can be separated from VAST elements"

Requirement: Parses a document that starts with a UTF-8 byte order mark.
VAST 4.3 basis: §2.2; §2.3.2 (XML 1.0: a UTF-8 byte order mark is allowed)
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "must be able to play the ad in a VAST response" / "compliant with XML 1.0"

Requirement: Reassembles an Impression URI split across two CDATA sections (query s=x]]>x).
VAST 4.3 basis: §2.3.3 (a URI containing "]]>" split across CDATA sections)
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "The media player is required to request the resource file for any included tracking elements from the URI provided" / "will be concatenated with the other two URI components"

Requirement: Accepts a UniversalAdId that still carries the VAST 4.0 idValue attribute.
VAST 4.3 basis: §3.7.1 (VAST 4.0 idValue attribute: players should not fail)
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "Media players should not fail if this attribute is present"

Requirement: An empty Impression element does not stop the other Impression from being requested.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "The media player is required to request the resource file for any included tracking elements"

Requirement: Accepts a VAST 3.0 InLine document.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "VAST 4 players should continue to accept ads on older versions of VAST"

Requirement: Accepts a VAST 2.0 InLine document.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "VAST 4 players should continue to accept ads on older versions of VAST"

Requirement: Follows a VAST 3.0 Wrapper to a VAST 4.3 InLine.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "VAST 4 players should continue to accept ads on older versions of VAST"

Requirement: Does not request an Impression element that sits entirely inside an XML comment (next to a real Impression).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "must be able to play the ad in a VAST response" / "acknowledge VAST comments in the standard XML syntax"

Requirement: Requests a VASTAdTagURI written as escaped text, with & between query parameters, with all parameters intact (a=1, b=2, c=3).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "character entities and <!--XML comments--> should be honored"

Requirement: Requests a VASTAdTagURI written as escaped text, with the character reference & between query parameters, with all parameters intact (a=1, b=2, c=3).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "character entities and <!--XML comments--> should be honored"

Requirement: Orders pod ads by their sequence attribute (document order is 3, 1, 2): the ad with sequence 1 comes first (or the pod is declined with an error; pod support is optional).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player must play the ads in the Pod in the prescribed sequence" / "sequenced ads are played in numerical order"

Requirement: When the second pod ad cannot play, playback continues with another ad (the stand-alone ad or the third pod ad).
VAST 4.3 basis: Ad Pods (an ad fails: move on)
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "If stand-alone ads are unavailable, the player should move on to the next ad in the Ad Pod."

Requirement: Playing a three-ad pod, each ad gets one impression and one complete, fired between its own impression and the next ad's.
VAST 4.3 basis: §2.3.4 (fire each tracker at the appropriate time); Ad Pods
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "required to request the resource file for any included tracking elements from the URI provided at the appropriate times" / "the same impression and tracking URIs in the VAST <Wrapper> are called as each ad in the Pod is played"

Requirement: The failed pod ad is replaced by the stand-alone ad from the response, after the first pod ad and before the third.
VAST 4.3 basis: Ad Pods (substitute an un-played stand-alone ad)
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player should substitute an un-played stand-alone ad from the response"

Requirement: Plays all three ads of a pod.
VAST 4.3 basis: Ad Pods (play the pod in sequence; play as many ads as possible)
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "all ads in the Pod should be played to the best of the player's ability" / "should play as many of the ads as possible" / "all ads in the Pod must be played to the best of the player's ability"

Requirement: Orders the pod ads of a Wrapper's target by their sequence attribute (document order 3, 1, 2; the Wrapper sets allowMultipleAds="true"): the ad with sequence 1 comes first (or the pod is declined with an error; pod support is optional).
VAST 4.3 basis: Ad Pods and Stand-Alone Ads (play the pod in the prescribed sequence); §3.19
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player must play the ads in the Pod in the prescribed sequence"

Requirement: When it does not execute the InLine's verification resource (a JavaScript resource with an apiFramework it does not implement), requests its verificationNotExecuted URI.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "The player must request each associated verificationNotExecuted tracking event URI" / "any appropriate tracking events listed under the <Verification> element must be fired"

Requirement: Fills [REASON] in verificationNotExecuted with a reason code (1, 2 or 3).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "with the [REASON] macro filled with reason code 1" / "Required" / "The following macros should be supported specifically in URIs for this event type"

Requirement: Handles the Wrapper's verification too: requests its verificationNotExecuted URI.
VAST 4.3 basis: Viewability with Ad Verification Services (resources from intermediary Wrappers)
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "All verification resources listed in the VAST should be executed, including those from any intermediary <Wrapper> VASTs"

Requirement: Reports a verification resource whose apiFramework it does not implement with reason 2 (verification not supported).
VAST 4.3 basis: §3.17.4 (reason code 2); §3.17.1; Viewability with Ad Verification Services
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the player must trigger any provided verificationNotExecuted tracking events with reason code 2"

Requirement: When an OMID verification resource fails to load (HTTP 404), requests its verificationNotExecuted URI with reason 3 (error during resource load).
VAST 4.3 basis: §3.17.4 (reason code 3: 404 or other failed response codes); Viewability with Ad Verification Services
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "any included verificationNotExecuted tracking events URIs must be sent with the appropriate reason code" / "404 or other failed response codes"

Requirement: Displays the Icon after the ad starts and requests its IconViewTracking URI.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the media player must display the object as an overlay on top of the Linear Ad with which the icon is served and after the ad has started" / "The player uses the included URI to notify the icon server when the icon has been displayed."

Requirement: On a click on the Icon, requests its IconClickTracking URI.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "The media player is required to request the resource file for any included tracking elements" / "is used to track click activity within the icon"

Requirement: Displays an Icon with offset 00:00:01 and duration 00:00:08 once playback passes 1 s, requesting its IconViewTracking URI.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "The time of delay from when the associated linear creative begins playing to when the icon should be displayed" / "The duration the icon should be displayed unless clicked or ad is finished playing"

Requirement: Skips a MediaFile of an unsupported type listed first (video/x-flv) and plays a supported one.
VAST 4.3 basis: MediaFiles (choose by attributes, not document order)
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "the publisher should decide which file to play based on attributes of the MediaFile nodes and not the structure of the document"

Requirement: Optional: plays an audio ad (adType="audio", Opus WebM and AAC files).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): "organizations may be compliant with VAST while only supporting a selected subset of the ad types" / "all ad types are relevant for “audio only” ads except NonLinear ads"

Requirement: A timed-out Wrapper request does not escape as an uncaught exception (which terminates a Node.js process).
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): (no VAST clause)

Requirement: A failed Wrapper request does not escape as an uncaught exception.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): (no VAST clause)

Requirement: Follows an HTTP 302 redirect on a VASTAdTagURI.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): (no VAST clause)

Requirement: Parses a VAST response sent with Content-Encoding: gzip.
Obligation text (VAST 4.3 or macro list): (no VAST clause)

Requirement: Parses a VAST response served as text/plain rather than an XML media type.
